messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable procedural creepy survival game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game in `index.html` using canvas, with no external game-engine dependency.
- Chosen mechanics: procedural forest paths, collect three echoes, conserve lantern battery, evade a pursuing creature, and reach the gate; keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game UI, procedural map generation, movement, stamina, lantern, collectibles, creature behavior, win/loss states, pause, touch controls, and optional ambient audio in `index.html`.
- `node --check /tmp/game.js` passed for the embedded JavaScript.

### Active
- Browser verification and gameplay checks remain unfinished.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli` and inspect the game; save and read a latest small JPEG screenshot.
2. Test starting, movement, and controls; fix any issues found.
3. Report assumptions and verification results to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: the game implementation.
- `/tmp/game.js`: extracted JavaScript used for the syntax check.

## Important Context
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable procedural creepy survival game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implement a standalone canvas browser game in `index.html`, with no external game-engine dependency.
- Game concept: explore a procedurally generated forest, collect three echoes, manage lantern battery and stamina, evade a pursuing creature, and reach the gate; keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a substantial game UI and canvas-game implementation to `index.html`, including procedural map generation, movement, stamina, lantern, collectibles, creature behavior, win/loss states, pause, touch controls, and optional ambient audio.
- Started a Python HTTP server on port `3002`.
- A JavaScript syntax check via `node --check /tmp/game.js` passed.

### Active
- Inspect and verify the current `index.html` in-browser; the file was rewritten in multiple chunks and then had `/tmp/finalchunk.html` appended, so confirm the final document structure and gameplay work.
- Check starting, movement, and controls; fix issues found.
- Save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli` and inspect the rendered page.
2. Check the final HTML/script structure and browser console; repair any issues, then test starting, movement, and controls.
3. Save a small JPEG screenshot at viewport width ≤1280px and inspect only that latest screenshot.
4. Report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game implementation; final markup may contain duplicate or appended content and needs inspection.
- `/tmp/game.js`: extracted JavaScript used for the syntax check.
- `/tmp/finalchunk.html`: earlier HTML copy appended to `index.html`; useful to compare if repairing the final file.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Browser verification and gameplay checks remain unfinished.
